post.message: Storm in the forecast? Before you start hauling in patio furniture, take a few minutes at the garage door. Look over the panels, check that the tracks are straight and bolted down, run the door through one full cycle and test the sensors near the floor. Springs and cables stay hands-off, though: if they look frayed or gapped, that's a job for a pro. We put the whole walk-around in one checklist for Miami homes.

review.notes: Independent subagent review: PASS; optional wording tweaks (drop five-minute claim, hurricane emoji) applied.
